# hivelocity_device_tags (Resource)

Manages the full list of tags on a device. Useful for tagging devices that were not provisioned by Terraform; devices created with `hivelocity_bare_metal_device` can use its `tags` argument instead. Destroying the resource removes all tags. The resource ID is the device ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tag a device that was not provisioned by Terraform.
resource "hivelocity_device_tags" "legacy" {
  device_id = 12345
  tags      = ["legacy", "do-not-reload"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags of the device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the device ID
terraform import hivelocity_device_tags.legacy 12345
```
